It may be extremely important to you. You sure you don't want to hear it?
<W>Someone in your Legion wants you dead.</>
Leon, shut her up.
What did you say?
Hehe, fine. I hope you won't regret your choice.
Secrets are meant to be whispered once. Take care, sir.
You crazy girl! What are you laughing at? Is this how you repay the Captain's kindness? Don't you feel guilty at all?
Guilty...? Ha, have you had too many alchemical concoctions from your Academy that damaged your brain?
Oh wait, I do feel guilty about one thing — to manipulate that stupid captain of yours, I lied about The Forsakens and blamed them for what the Empire did to us. I'm so sorry to The Forsakens!
You—!
Oh, look what the cat dragged in. Hello, dear sir.
I'll take it from here.
So what are you doing here? Come to show off the benevolence of a Hyperborean officer? Or perhaps you pity this poor girl who's been led "astray," trying to save me from my "sins"?
Oh, I get it! You want to join The Forsakens, right? Need a reference?
Hey — you guys hear that? Your captain wants to join The Forsakens!

options.content: Save it. No one would give you any attention.
Yeah, I'm interested. Who's your contact?
You had many chances for an ambush. Why played the long game?
(Give her a punch to shut her up)

talks.content: Oh, no. This is so sad. Boohoo whoo.
Oh honey, you really suck at this. Save it — you won't get anything from me. Lowlives who betray their comrades and sell intel to their enemy only exist in your beloved Legion.
Because you're always so on guard. I couldn't find a chance, even while we were alone. I had to bide my time patiently. Even offered you help a couple of times to lower your guard.
Oww, it hurts! Someone do something about this! An armed soldier's hitting a helpless young girl!
You...
And it's more fun this way! Betrayal by a trusted friend is far more memorable than a stab from a stranger, isn't it?
Aww, you look like an angry bull. I'm so sorry, sir! I forgot you like it better when I talk like this.
...Cut the act, and answer my question.
Sure! Ask away. I'll answer whenever I feel like it.
I deserve to know why you stabbed us in the back after I helped you. Is it out of plain hatred for the Hyperborean Legion, or an assassination attempt targeting me specifically?
If this is your question... Sure, I can answer that — given that you've been naive enough to fall for my trick.
The Forsakens simply want all Hyperborean dogs to die here, and preferably at the hands of the killing machines they created — I hope you enjoyed our fiery gift.
As for me... Well, I personally came for <H>you</>!

I heard that you, the top graduate of the Imperial Military College, who is also known as the "Pale Reaper," were coming to Lonza Fortress. How could I not come have a good look at the Pale Reaper myself?
You've heard about me? Have we met before?
Hehe, that's for you to guess.
My sources said that our great {性别2:Mr|Miss} Pale Reaper only has a few years' worth of memories. You know nothing of your past. You don't even know where you came from.
Let's play a game then! Now, honey, take a guess — was I your neighbour, an old nemesis—
Or a complete stranger? Maybe I just hate you for being one of Hyperborea's honorable people, and I simply wish to destroy that which they cherish?
<W>Your head hurts, right? The jabbering of this mad girl is worming through your skull like a leech sucking at your brains.</>

<W>See, you have a sword in your hand. That's right — it's the one you've wielded in countless battles. The hilt still carries your warmth. You're familiar with the slick feeling and the subtle tug of resistance when its blade slices through flesh.</>
<W>You can easily slit this creature's throat and make its detestable lips gurgle and whimper in pain.</>
(It's... that voice again! Why now...?)

options.content: (Follow the voice and reach for the sword)

talks.content: ENOUGH!!! Shut up!!
Why suddenly so quiet? You seemed ready to lecture me. Cat got your tongue, honey?
...Okay, looks like somebody needs anger management here.
<W>I am the origin of your soul, the impulse within the deepest recesses of your mind. Do not refuse me... Listen — I am the one who gave you power and made you invincible in battle.</>
<W>Unsheathe your sword, the one that bears the killing razor.</>

options.content: (Follow the voice and try to draw the sword)

talks.content: Go on, make your guess — any guess would do, because I won't tell you the truth anyway!
<W>Do not hesitate! Use your sword! It's calling to you! It thirsts for the sweet joy that can only be sated by flesh and blood.</>
<W>Quick! Silence this mad lass for good!</>

options.content: (Follow the voice and wield the sword)

talks.content: Go, stay in touch, and be careful.
Vic...
I found this on Vic. Thought you should have it.
His identity disc...
"Monica — next time, I'm beating you at the shooting range." ...Heh. Haha... That idiot. What kind of farewell is that...
If I'd known he'd be that petty... maybe I would've let him win...
...Monica. We've got another fight ahead. Stay sharp.
I... Yes, sir. And thank you... for bringing this back.
Behave! Captain's orders — no sudden moves or funny business, alright?
But if I'm not allowed to move, how am I supposed to lead the way...?
Right, you have a point there.
There's no need to so on guard. We Charons are ordinary people too, with families we're desperate to see again.
...*sigh* Katya...
...Captain, why did you stop me!?
Not all Charons are rebels from The Forsakens — Commander Avar is a Charon, remember? And even if they are, they'd be worth more to us alive.
...An inner voice might tell you otherwise, Marco, but don't listen to it. Don't let emotions cloud your judgment.

Damn those friggin' rotters!

options.content: I failed to protect you. I'm sorry.

talks.content: Captain! I'm fine, I can still move... Hssss—
Please don't say that, Captain! You did your best!
Who else could it be? The bastards who call themselves The Forsakens.
Those despicable cowards are using Filthoids as their weapon... <W>The Forsakens</> are monsters, just like their Filthoid pets!
And those blasted airheads giving us the orders are just as bad. The mission brief mentioned nothing about the Filthoid hordes down here.
...Sorry about that. I shouldn't have vented my frustration in front of you, Captain.
It's alright. Letting out emotions is better than being unable to speak at all.
Hah! You always know how to soothe people, Captain!
And thank goodness we have you. We thought we were goners.
It's just that we're too green. If only <H>Commander Avar</> were here... As a veteran, he must have a way to get us out.
Doctor... Dr Daphne... We're stuck in this bloody dump. Please, Dr Daphne, if I don't make it, do me a favour and bury me...

options.content: Don't be discouraged. It'll worsen your wounds.
Right, keep raising your voice to attract the Filthoids.

talks.content: We're out of painkillers... so I have to grumble a bit to make myself feel better.
Sorry, Captain. I'll zip it. With no painkillers left, I can only grumble a little to help distract me from the pain.
Dr Daphne and you covered our retreat just then. How is she?
She's all right. She told me to come check on all of you.
Good to hear that. *sigh* A high-born lady like her could've stayed at the Academy, but no, she chose to serve with the 13th Legion. What was she thinking?
..."Eternal glory and loyalty to our Emperor!" Those aristocrats say that all the time. I wonder if any of them would still be so keen on that when they're actually in a filth pit like this.
But Dr Daphne has real medical skills and a soft, pretty voice. We gotta keep her safe, Captain. Don't want her to die here.

name: Return to Main Storyline: Chapter Twilight

talks.content: (A loud man is holding court, his dramatic recitations drawing bursts of laughter from the patrons.)
Phantoms from the deep mountains, ghosts from the Icelake itself!
They're pressing in! They're getting closer!
Hey, you're here.
I don't have any proper jobs for you at the moment, but...
...You can hardly imagine!
A phantom!!! A silent stalker that ignores the doors!!!
As you can see, we've got a bit of a situation here.

Mr Buck. Can't handle even a drop of alcohol — so it's always fruit juice or milk for him. Profession... third-rate playwright, first-rate producer of mumble-jumble. He's been spinning his yarns for a while now.
As you can see, the man struggles to convey his thoughts clearly. Could you help by translating his flamboyant narratives?

options.content: Perhaps sorting out Mr Buck's convoluted vocabulary and reorganising the keywords would clarify his script.

talks.content: Only a sharp mind like yours is suited for this task.
The Asphodel offer more than just libations... much more. All for a price, naturally.

options.content: Please tell me more about Icelake.
Please tell me more about Phoxhunters.
Please tell me more about yourself.

talks.content: Where to begin... Well, it's got a long history. Built by the Empire's first ruler after the Great Migration 800 years ago, it's among the first few cities of the empire.

A bunch of cheap, noisy blighters keen on spinning yarns. Some of them became Phoxhunters to eke a living, some just fancy a bit of ruckus and adventure. One thing they have in common is they often end up more battered and bruised than not.
Hasn't anyone told you it's rather rude to pry into a lady's secrets for no reason?
It's also the northernmost major city of the Empire. Just over a hundred kilometres further north, past the Vidofnir Mountains, and you're on Askard's turf.
Truth be told, I've often wanted to give them the boot, let them munch on dirty snow and gulp the north wind outside.
Of course, I can share my stories with you — provided you can pay the right price... hehe.

Icelake used to be known for its Phoxene veins. Take Glevum Pit for example — one of Hyperborea's largest Phoxene mines back in the day. But now, the veins are spent, only the old factories are barely chugging along.
But then, they do manage a fair bit that ought to be the Security Bureau's job. Without them, likely not many in this city would have the luxury to kick back in my tavern.

But then, this is all stuff you can read about in books, things anyone could tell you. I'd suggest you look with your own eyes and listen with your heart, to find out what truly lurks beneath this city's snow and ice.
So I let them gather and natter here, a bit of quid pro quo. Still, I do wish they'd keep it down a little and get into fewer brawls.
Keep your nose out of things that don't concern you.
(Before even enter The Asphodel, you already hear the echoing curse words, as if wanting the whole city to listen to his rage.)
How dare you show yourself in front of my face! I was such a fool. I should have done more than just kick you out!
You paraded around with our family name for so many years. Did you use my warning letters as kindling?
Yes, yes, you are right, but after all, that surname is what you...
(Wells, like a child who's misbehaved, stands with his head bowed in front of an old man, allowing the latter's finger to jab at him.)

Shut up! You have no talent, yet you try to be a Phoxhunter. Do you really think you deserve this money and fame? Running around like a dog for others. The inner city now sees the Wells family as a joke!
I was just thinking, if I make something of myself someday, maybe you'll reconsider things about me and Sara—
How dare you mention her name! Forget about it. You and my daughter will never get back together, never!
Don't say I didn't warn you. If you dare step foot in the inner city, I'll break your legs.
Yeah, yeah...
(The old man, glaring at the nodding Wells, grows even more infuriated, looking around and finally setting his eyes on you, who just enters The Asphodel.)
And you, a Phoxhunter? I've seen many like you, dreaming of making a name for yourself as a Phoxhunter, and becoming a laurelled Charon.
Let me tell you something. <H>Icelake hasn't had many living laurelled Charons for years.</> Charons only end up rotting in some dark alley!
Father-in-law, {nickname} is a capable one, not a loser like me...
Mr. Ferdinand Wells, I had no right to interfere what happened between you two. But if you keep harassing my other guests for no reason like this, The Asphodel might have to show you the door.
(Camilla, sitting behind the counter, puffs out a ring of smoke. Her casual words echoing powerfully in the empty tavern.)
(As if the temperature in The Asphodel rose significantly in the smoke.)

options.content: Mr. Wells isn't as bad as you say. You're pushing things too far.
We have no interest in becoming laurelled Charon. Don't try to put everyone into a box with your shallow understanding.
Watch your mouth. Otherwise, another "Mr. Wells" might end up getting beaten up like a dog today.

talks.content: ...Hmph.
(The elder is left speechless by your words, and glares fiercely before storming out.)
Sorry for causing everyone so much trouble. Well, my father-in-law... I mean Mr. Ferdinand Wells hasn't been to the outer city for years.
Let's just say he's more... traditional. Don't take his words to heart.
It's alright. We wouldn't be here today if we gave in to every slight or insult. Anyway, I heard you were injured recently during a commission. Are you okay?
It's nothing. Luckily this thing saved me from being fatally injured.
(Wells takes out a finely crafted pocket watch from his chest. The dial is covered in cracks, and the hands are twisted upwards in an exaggerated manner, making closing the watch cover a mere wish.)

options.content: The shape of these cracks... I see. It protected you from a fatal blow to the chest.
...Mr. Wells, no matter how hard life is, you shouldn't steal someone else's watch.

talks.content: He made it himself. Over a decade ago, there wasn't a soul who hadn't heard of Todd Wells, the prodigy clockmaker. Back then, his craftsmanship almost won him the title of Laurelled Charon.
Such a beautifully crafted watch. It's a pity it cracked like that.
Haha. Actually the hands had been broken for a long time, you know. I just keep it with me as a memento.
Why don't you try to fix it then?
The tools and materials needed for repairs were cut off by my father-in-law, so even if I wanted to fix it, I just couldn't.
...It's the way it is. Not everything can be fixed just because you want to and put effort into it.
Anyway! Enough about that. Thanks again for stepping in — if you hadn't, I'd be half-deaf by now from all that yelling.
Come on, drinks are on me tonight! I'll crack open these kegs — you handle those ones over there!
Come on, let's drink and party all night!
Back already? Shouldn't you be following Henrik?
{nickname}, did you manage to find the soil?
No, not yet.
It's alright. You don't need to go to all this trouble for me...
Oh, before I forget — I have a couple of questions:

Have you ever stood under the Heaventree? Are the legends really true — is the Heaventree so massive that its crown covers the entire sky? Could we see... a glittering canopy of crystals looking up its trunk?
And... and another question — is the sandy beach really as soft and smooth as they say — malleable like dough, and not at all rough on the feet?
Sorry for bombarding you with so many questions! I'm asking for my friends at the inn... Hehe, they are all very fascinated by your hometown.

Feel free to go back to Icelake, {性别:Sir|Miss}. With Filbert here with me, I'll be just fine.

options.content: Don't your family worry about you, running around in the wild all the time?

talks.content: Hehe, we get that a lot. Don't let her size fool you, she's actually really gentle and sweet. Oh, and she's amazing at sniffing out food!

I don't have any family. I was too young when we got separated, so I don't remember them. But I've got Filbert now, and she's the best family I could ask for! She always looks out for me, so I think she's not worried!
Too bad it's too cold around here for mushrooms to grow, or I'd totally show you how we can find an entire hill of Russulas in just half a day!
Oink, oink!
Mist Aken's got no entertainment at all... There's gotta be an untapped market hiding somewhere. I'll figure something out... sooner or later...
May your virtue endure for all time.
Another boatload just came in, lads! Make sure the list is right before you start hauling. Don't rush it — or you'll just mess it up.
Ah, there you are, {性别:young man|young lass}! See something you fancy? Take whatever you like — Miss Zhiliu's guest is my guest too.

options.content: Is business good down by the docks, selling all this?
So Proprietress Zhiliu once helped you out too?

talks.content: Haha, business is just knowing what folks need and getting it to 'em. That's the first trick any Starweaver learns.
Years back, I'd put my whole life's savings into one shipload of goods — and wouldn't you know it, we ran into a storm and everything went under. Half a life's savings, gone in a single night.
Once a Starweaver heads out, they're stuck on the ship for a month or so at a time.
I went to EverSpring to ask for more time on my loan, and happened to run into Proprietress Zhiliu. She heard my story, cleared the debt on the spot, and even gave me some seed money to start over.
There's always some scatterbrain who realises, right before they push off, that they've forgotten this or that. That's when my bits and bobs come in handy — and the prices are fair, mind you!
To her, it was probably nothing much. To me, it changed my whole life.
And travellers waiting for the ferry out of Huaxu usually grab a few souvenirs too. That gives the sales a bit of a boost.
I paid that back ages ago, but I've kept her kindness in mind ever since. So, {性别:young man|young lass} — if you ever need a hand, just say the word.
Plus, I've got a neat little money-making trick of my own...
That sachet I gave you isn't just some common item you can find on just any stall — it's a limited edition, officially licensed by the Xuanheng Sect.
Only a handful of places in Huaxu can sell these, each with its own design. Sachet lovers come running. My stall's even on the must-visit lists in Mistwharf.
Ah, it's you. How are you finding EverSpring? Starting to get the feel of the place?
If anything feels difficult while you're settling in, just come to me. I'll help however I can.
{nickname}, is there anything else you wish to ask? I will answer whatever I can.
You must be the honoured guest Miss Zhiliu invited all the way from Hyperborea. I didn't expect you to be so young and so good-loo— ahem... I mean, so accomplished!
Proprietress Zhiliu is often occupied, with very little time to spare. If there's anything we may have overlooked, please let me know — I'll attend to it immediately.
(Before you, the wounded Magistrate of Yingtian sinks into a deep sleep, his brow tightly furrowed. He doesn't seem to be waking anytime soon...)
(Do Magistrates of Yingtian dream as well? What does he see in his dreams? You can't help wondering.)
Whatcha doing, little minion? Admiring my masterpiece?
If you like it, I can doodle something cute on your face too! Perks of being my minion!
...Thanks, Snow. Come on, we should get moving.
Hey, you two — so you really are Proprietress Zhiliu's guests, huh.
I'm on the lookout here every day. People try to sneak into the market all the time — I've heard every excuse under the sun. But I've never seen anyone as reckless as you two.
Since you're Mr Qiu's honoured guests now... heh, could you put in a good word for me with the boss? Just tell him that his man Zhang San is ready to work himself to the bone to serve him!

I'm stuck keeping watch here every damn day — staring so long I'm starting to see the other side of Tidesong Cavern in my sleep. And hey, luck's supposed to turn, right? Shouldn't it be my turn to land a gig with some actual payoff?
You can't keep dumping all the dirty work on one poor man, right? I mean, tell me I'm not wrong here.
Ah, you're here. Sit down, my young friend.
I've just brewed a cup of tangerine peel tea, aged for centuries. Let it soothe your throat, then indulge me with tales of your travels.
Th—Thank you... for saving my life...
(The young woman before you is pale as a ghost, sweat beading on her brow. Even so, she forces herself to thank you. After the Bi'an's punishment, she clearly needs rest.)
Don't worry, {性别：sir|ma'am} — we're all friends here! I'll take good care of her, not a single hair out of place! I swear it!
Please... {性别：sir|ma'am}, I'm begging you here — please go see Mr Qiu first! Don't keep him waiting. With you standing here, the girl just can't calm down and rest, can she?
So, my honorary learner — what is it you want to ask?
Look who it is — {nickname}, the hero who helped lead EverSpring through the crisis!
You flatter me. I only played a small part — most of the credit goes to Proprietress Zhiliu and everyone else.
And you? After all that's happened, how have you been?

It may sound a little silly, but instead of feeling shaken afterward, I actually felt... exhilarated. There was a quiet thrill in being able to protect our home, as though a steady strength had taken root within me.
I even found myself thinking about learning some basic self-defense, so that when I travel to more perilous regions for trade, I won't have to rely entirely on my escorts.
Although... thoughts like these do stray from the teachings of the Nine Chapters of Dafeng...
What is it, {nickname}? Was there something you wished to discuss?
(Her composure seems unchanged, yet you sense a faint weariness beneath it — something easy to overlook. Perhaps it is only your imagination.)
You... my lifesaver... you came to see me...
Are you feeling any better now?
Thanks to the herbs you and Lady Fushu brought back for me, my injuries have started to settle. In another day or two, I might even be able to get out of bed and walk.

After everything that's happened, you've shown me more kindness than I can even put into words... I... I really don't know how to repay you. If there's ever anything I can do for you, just say the word. I'll do my best.
If you come across any Wishen stranded near the waterfall, please lend them your aid. My thanks to both of you.
My heartfelt thanks. With all the missing Wishen safely returned, we are deeply grateful for your help.
{nickname}, you've come.

I am accustomed to quietude, and here in the Hall of Ephemerality I have little with which to receive you — only these shelves of medical texts and a pot of tea. I hope it does not strike you as too dull.
You may move about as you please. Please make yourself at ease here.
Eee-ya... eeee-ya, eee!
(It drifts beside Fushu, looking content.)
You may proceed to the highest point of the Gritblight Expanse. The temporary path to the Zhuyin Altar has already been completed.
Once the rite begins, Zhuyin may grow agitated and lash out. The area around the altar will be extremely dangerous, so please be very careful.
Phoxhunter, please take care. Your safety is our utmost priority. I'll remain here and await your return.
Sister Feng is no longer with me... but she's happy now. I can feel it.

name: 垃圾桶1号补充（小）【待包装】

talks.content: (A faithful companion who stayed by Fina's side through many lonely days in the cold, grand manor. Mr. White Bird, with his soft feathers and wide, gentle wings.)
(Though they were once separated, thanks to Savio, Mr. White Bird has now returned to Fina. From now on, he will keep watching over her with those round, glistening eyes.)

Take a Seat for the Show
Man Who Looks Like a Bodyguard
